    a p ℓ : Level

    xs ys : Vector A n

-- map

map⁺ :  ∀ {f : A → B} → (∀ {x} → P x → Q (f x)) →
        All P xs → All Q (VF.map f xs)
map⁺ pq ps i = pq (ps i)

replicate⁺ : P x → All P (replicate n x)
replicate⁺ = const

-- _⊛_

⊛⁺ : ∀ {fs : Vector (A → B) n} →
     All (λ f → ∀ {x} → P x → Q (f x)) fs →
     All P xs → All Q (fs ⊛ xs)
